component.name: HyperX Linux
component.summary: Control panel for HyperX headsets, mice, keyboards and microphones

description.p: An unofficial replacement for NGENUITY on Linux: battery, microphone mute and monitoring, equalizer, auto power-off, DPI, polling rate and lighting for HyperX peripherals, with a tray icon, notifications and a command line.
Not affiliated with HP or HyperX.
